```yaml
name: Deploy Docs

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'fastlane/metadata/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'fastlane/metadata/**'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install VitePress
        run: npm install -g vitepress

      - name: Copy assets to public
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/.vitepress/public
          # Copy root assets (excluding docs, .github, .git, node_modules)
          rsync -av --exclude='docs' --exclude='.github' --exclude='.git' --exclude='node_modules' . docs/.vitepress/public/
          # Copy fastlane metadata
          rsync -av fastlane/metadata/ docs/.vitepress/public/

      - name: Build VitePress site
        run: vitepress build docs

      - name: Upload built site
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs
          path: docs/.vitepress/dist

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download built site
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs
          path: ./docs

      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        with:
          static_site_generator: vitepress
          generator_config_file: docs/.vitepress/config.js

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          artifact_name: docs
          preview: false
```
